query: What is the current status of the 2026 Tour de France as of 13 July 2026? Latest general classification standings, has Tadej Pogačar retained the yellow jersey, any crashes or abandonments, current gap to Vingegaard.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings on the 2026 Tour de France as of 13 July 2026:

**Status:** The race had just completed **Stage 9** (Malemort → Ussel, 155.5 km, won by Mathieu van der Poel from a breakaway) — the last stage before the first rest day.

**Yellow jersey:** ✅ **Tadej Pogačar retained yellow**, leading the GC into the rest day.

**Gap to Vingegaard:** **+2:42** (built mainly on the Stage 6 Tourmalet solo win).

**GC top 4:** Pogačar → Vingegaard (+2:42) → del Toro (+3:27) → Evenepoel (+3:30).

**Crashes/abandonments:** The standout was **Torstein Træen** (former yellow-jersey wearer), who crashed on the Tourmalet on Stage 6 and quit before Stage 7. Others out in week 1: Berthet, De Lie, Uijtdebroeks, Van Lerberghe, de Kleijn. No GC contenders abandoned.

One important caveat I flagged: many aggregator pages surface later-stage (13–20) data at the same URLs, so I carefully isolated the state as of Stage 9 / 13 July 2026, and discarded one conflicting gap figure that traced to a later stage.
